text:
carmen-devex: FYI found a parity quirk between the REST endpoint and the Python SDK when using the embeddings batch flag. curl to /v1/embeddings?allow_partials=1 returns 200 with partials, but python client call with allow_partials=True gives a 400 with a weird error envelope.

hiro-py-sdks: thanks, can you paste the exact curl + client snippet and SDK version?

carmen-devex: using py client 0.9.3. repro: 
```
# REST
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings?allow_partials=1\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $T\" -d '{"model":"micro-embed","inputs":["ok","bad"]}'
```
Python: 
```py
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv('TOKEN'))
c.embeddings.create(model='micro-embed', inputs=['ok','bad'], allow_partials=True)
```
REST -> 200, body includes partial vectors and a per-item error list. Python SDK -> 400, body: {"error":{"type":"unknown_param","message":"allowPartials"}}.

leo-samples: our onboarding quickstart uses the py client in the tutorial; CI started failing after a docs PR that added a batched example. New users hit this fast.

nina-api: quick background: the server expects allow_partials as a query flag on batch endpoints. We also changed the error envelope to include per-item errors under errors[]. The python SDK's request builder serializes unknown flags into the JSON body camelCased (allowPartials) and our request validator rejects unknown body keys, returning that unknown_param error.

hiro-py-sdks: couple of things to fix: 1) param normalization for python should map known camelCase/pyic names (allow_partials / allowPartials / allowPartials) to the query param allow_partials when the endpoint is a batch; 2) sdk currently unwraps 4xx into a generic exception type and loses the errors[] list — CI consumers rely on that envelope to implement per-item fallbacks.

carmen-devex: yep losing the per-item errors means samples can't decide which inputs to retry individually, so teams either re-run whole batch (costly) or fail.

hiro-py-sdks: plan: emit allow_partials in query when present, accept camelCase aliases in ctor/options, and preserve the server error envelope on 4xx so callers can inspect errors[]. Also found the retry behavior: server sends HTTP Retry-After on 429, but our python retryer checked X-Retry-After-Ms only. We'll update the precedence to prefer Retry-After header, fallback to vendor header.

qa-bot: Created ticket RDW-5512: python-sdk: allow_partials query mapping + error-envelope preservation. Linked PR: fix/py-embeddings-allow-partials (#409) by hiro-py-sdks. CI triggered.

leo-samples: can you add a small smoke test to samples/ci that compares curl vs py-client for status + presence of errors[]/data[] keys? That would have caught this earlier.

hiro-py-sdks: will add a lightweight shape-diff smoke test and a changelog entry: "Python SDK 0.9.4: accept allow_partials aliasing, normalize to server query params, and preserve server error envelope; prefer standard Retry-After header for backoff."

nina-api: we'll continue emitting both Retry-After and X-Retry-After-Ms for a release window. Also adding a server-side compatibility test so validators don't regress.

carmen-devex: great — thanks. Once merged we'll bump the quickstart and re-run onboarding CI. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
